name: @aws-sdk/client-eventbridge
description: AWS SDK for JavaScript Eventbridge Client for Node.js, Browser and React Native

readme.summary: Generic AWS SDK v3 README that covers the broader SDK well but provides no EventBridge-specific content, examples, or guidance.
readme.top_issue: README is entirely about the generic AWS SDK v3 and DynamoDB examples — contains zero EventBridge-specific content, making it useless for someone trying to use @aws-sdk/client-eventbridge.

common_complaints: Package publication order causing dependency resolution failures
Test infrastructure brittleness with local backends
sentiment.summary: AWS SDK team is actively closing issues but struggling with release infrastructure (dependency ordering) and has unresolved long-standing performance regressions (Lambda coldstart pending for 12+ months).

red_flags: Some responses are brief and could be more detailed for complex issues
Lack of examples in some technical explanations
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful, clear, and patient. They provide a good balance of technical depth and user-friendliness, though there is room for improvement in detail and example usage.
